$comment: Single source of truth for the catalogue. Prices are data, not code: edit them here (or replace this file with an admin/CMS feed) and every page, cart and checkout picks them up. `pricesArePlaceholders` marks the launch pricing as unconfirmed — set it to false once the owner approves final prices.

sizes.name: Mini
sizes.note: A little loaf for one or two.

products.name: Classic Banana Bread
products.tagline: The one that started it all.
products.description: Deeply caramelised bananas, a soft golden crumb and a crackly top — baked the way banana bread should be. Simple, warm and impossible to stop at one slice.
products.ingredients: Ripe bananas, wheat flour, brown sugar, free-range eggs, butter, vanilla, sea salt

products.name: Red Velvet Banana Bread
products.description: Velvety cocoa crumb with a gentle banana sweetness and a cream-cheese ripple. Rich, ruby-red and made to be the centrepiece of the table.
products.ingredients: Ripe bananas, wheat flour, cocoa, buttermilk, cream cheese, beetroot, sugar, eggs, butter

products.name: Oreo Banana Bread
products.description: Our classic loaf folded with crushed Oreo cookies and finished with a vanilla glaze. The kind of bake that disappears before it cools.
products.ingredients: Ripe bananas, wheat flour, Oreo cookies, sugar, eggs, butter, vanilla, milk

products.name: Chocolate Chunk Banana Bread
products.description: A tender banana crumb studded with generous dark chocolate chunks that melt into pockets as it bakes. Best served slightly warm.
products.ingredients: Ripe bananas, wheat flour, dark chocolate (70%), sugar, eggs, butter, cocoa, vanilla

products.name: Chocolate Chip Banana Bread
products.description: Our classic banana crumb folded through with small chocolate chips that keep their shape as they bake. Soft, sweet and familiar — banana bread with a little extra chocolate.
products.ingredients: Ripe bananas, wheat flour, chocolate chips, sugar, eggs, butter, vanilla

products.name: Nutella Banana Bread
products.description: Banana bread marbled with hazelnut cocoa spread and topped with toasted hazelnuts. Sweet, nutty and unapologetically indulgent.
products.ingredients: Ripe bananas, wheat flour, hazelnut cocoa spread, sugar, eggs, butter, hazelnuts, vanilla

products.name: Mixed Nuts Banana Bread
products.description: Toasted almonds, cashews and walnuts scattered over a deep, moist banana crumb. Nutty, textured and just sweet enough.
products.ingredients: Ripe bananas, wheat flour, almonds, cashews, walnuts, sugar, eggs, butter, cinnamon

products.name: Coconut Banana Bread
products.description: Coconut milk, desiccated coconut and ripe banana baked into a soft, fragrant loaf. A quiet holiday in every bite.
products.ingredients: Ripe bananas, wheat flour, coconut milk, desiccated coconut, sugar, eggs, butter, vanilla

products.name: Baileys Banana Bread
products.description: A generous splash of Baileys Irish Cream folded into banana bread, finished with a cocoa dust. For the adults at the table.
products.ingredients: Ripe bananas, wheat flour, Baileys Irish Cream, cocoa, sugar, eggs, butter, vanilla
